warning_acceptance.glb_seams: GLB import preserves normal/material seam copies. Bidirectional positions, bounds and per-material triangle counts match exactly without import repair. Exported hoses are visibly more faceted than smooth source curves at close range.
warning_acceptance.uv: Constant-color untextured materials intentionally omit UVs.
